hints.title: Individual Travel Time Computation
hints.text: Calculate the individual travel duration for each person based on distance divided by speed.

hints.title: Sorted Order Batching
hints.text: Sort the completion durations to pack individuals into batches with capacity k.

hints.title: Batch Bottleneck Determination
hints.text: Each batch duration is dominated by the slowest individual assigned to that group.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minTimeToTransport(self, positions: List[int], speeds: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        times = [(pos + spd - 1) // spd for pos, spd in zip(positions, speeds)]
        times.sort()
        # Batches of size k: each batch takes max time of the batch
        # To transport all individuals, group into batches of up to k
        batches = [times[i] for i in range(k - 1, len(times), k)]
        if len(times) % k != 0:
            batches.append(times[-1])
        return max(batches) if batches else 0
```
